metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over how to prevent sciatica pain when sitting with three EASY exercises.

These exercises can be done anywhere, and only require the chair you're sitting in. They focus on relieving tension and pressure off the sciatic nerve QUICKLY. 

This not only makes them great towards helping to prevent future sciatica pain, but the exercises can also be used to ease current sciatica pain.

Watch now and get some quick sciatica relief!
